typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Premium Creator. High weight contrast, tight tracking for headings. Clean and highly legible geometric body font.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (p-6 to p-8) for structural containers, tightly packed (p-2 to p-4) for internal components like chips and thumbnails.

anatomy.header: Sticky with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0B10]/80). Contains Logo and Mode Segmented Toggle (Avatar vs Faceless).
anatomy.script_area: Large, borderless or subtle 1px border. Focus state glows with accent color. Ample line-height (leading-relaxed) and text-lg for easy reading.
anatomy.chip_row: Horizontal flex row, gap-3, directly below the script area. Each chip is pill-shaped (rounded-full).
anatomy.modals: Centered, contained max-h-[80vh] with internal scrolling. Backdrop: backdrop-blur-md bg-black/60. Top sticky area for tabs/search.
anatomy.storyboard_strip: Horizontal scrolling flex container, gap-4, placed above Generate button. Thumbnails with duration overlay.
anatomy.cta_area: Bottom sticky or visually prominent section with a massive Generate button (w-full or max-w-md), using Accent Primary.
anatomy.recent_renders: Grid or vertical stack of cards below CTA. Includes thumbnail, meta chips, and play/delete actions.

components.mode_toggle: Segmented control, pill shape. Active: surface_primary bg, Text Primary. Inactive: transparent bg, Text Secondary.
components.chips: Compact pills (h-8 px-4 text-sm). Default: border-border_subtle bg-surface_primary. Hover: border-border_focus. Active (selected): ring-1 ring-accent_primary text-accent_primary.
components.avatar_card: Vertical rectangle (aspect ratio approx 3:4). On hover: play button overlay. Selected state: 2px solid accent_primary border and a '✓ Selected' floating badge.
components.voice_card: Horizontal row or compact square. Includes Play button (▶). Selected state: highlight border and checkmark.
components.scene_card: For Faceless mode. Includes text prompt input and stock search results grid. Video thumbnails have bottom-right duration overlay (e.g., '0:05') and top-left source badge.
components.progress_card: Dynamic rendering state. Progress bar using accent_primary. Status label updates: Queued -> Voiceover -> Visuals -> Composing -> Complete.
components.buttons: CTAs are highly rounded (rounded-full or rounded-xl). Primary CTA uses accent_primary with hover lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.

interactions.modal_entry: Framer motion scale-up (0.95 to 1) with opacity fade-in (0 to 1).
interactions.chip_click: Opens corresponding modal. No inline expanding galleries.
interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly. Play buttons appear. Borders transition to lighter shade.
interactions.defaults: DO NOT silently pick defaults. Show default choices as initial chip values. Captions ON for 9:16, OFF for 16:9.

empty_script_hint.description: Dark blank vintage notebook, used as an empty state visual next to the script textarea.

empty_renders.description: Empty vintage cinema hall in the dark, used for the 'No Recent Renders' state.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., data-testid='mode-toggle-avatar', data-testid='generate-video-button', data-testid='chip-avatar-select').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the UI acts as a 'Studio', not a basic form. The layout must match HeyGen/Jogg.ai workspace patterns: large primary input (script) and compact configuration (chips).
NEVER build inline galleries. All heavy selection lists (Voices, Avatars, Stock Media) MUST open in a centered modal dialog.
Implement the custom Mode Switcher (Avatar vs Faceless) as a segmented toggle pill near the top.
Faceless mode must include a 'B-Roll Source' chip. Avatar mode replaces this with an 'Avatar' chip.
Do not expose vendor names (HeyGen, Pexels) in the UI text. Keep it white-labeled (e.g., 'Stock Video', 'AI Generation').
All chips must visually display the currently selected value (e.g., instead of just 'Voice', show 'Voice: Sarah (US)').
Implement 9:16 and 16:9 conditional logic for Captions default state as requested.
Use data-testid on all key interactive elements.
